page_title: INT 2-0 PAR | Inter v Parma 03/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90+2' Inter are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Parma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
89' Cristian Chivu has decided to substitute Nicolo Barella and he is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
86' Nesta Elphege (Parma) has a goal ruled out for offside!
85' That will be all from Emanuele Valeri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Franco Carboni (Parma).
84' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) makes a rough challenge and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle for a foul.
80' 2 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Lautaro Martinez is the provider as he slips the ball to Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 2:0.
78' Lautaro Martinez (Inter) finds his way to a rebound on the edge of the box, shoots to the middle of the goal, but the keeper is ready and denies him.
77' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
77' The ball is cleared after Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Inter force a corner. They send men into the box.
75' Carlos Cuesta prepares a substitution. Gabriel Strefezza is replaced by Pontus Almqvist (Parma).
75' Here is a change. Adrian Bernabe Garcia is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
72' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar.
67' Mandela Keita comes off the pitch to be replaced by Christian Ordonez (Parma).
67' Cristian Chivu has decided to make a change. Lautaro Martinez (Inter) replaces Marcus Thuram.
66' Substitution. Mateo Pellegrino makes way for Nesta Elphege (Parma).
66' A substitution has been made. Alessandro Bastoni goes off and Carlos Augusto (Inter) comes on.
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Henrikh Mkhitaryan (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Piotr Zielinski.
64' Kevin Bonacina shows a yellow card to Piotr Zielinski (Inter) for his blatant foul.
64' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
63' Poor challenge! Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is penalised for tripping and Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle.
61' Inter take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
61' A lofted cross from Denzel Dumfries (Inter) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
58' Petar Sucic (Inter) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
53' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter).
53' Federico Dimarco (Inter) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Inter will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
50' Petar Sucic (Inter) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Kevin Bonacina saw the whole situation.
48' Inter are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
46' Cristian Chivu has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ange-Yoan Bonny (Inter) replacing Francesco Pio Esposito.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.

45+1' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Marcus Thuram (Inter). Piotr Zielinski plays a fantastic through ball and finds Marcus Thuram (Inter), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the left side of the goal. It's now 1:0.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
42' Federico Dimarco (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Parma will have a goal kick.
39' Inter keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
36' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
32' Marcus Thuram (Inter) times his run well to meet a lofted cross near the penalty spot, but mistimes his header and sends the ball high over the bar.

30' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
30' Federico Dimarco (Inter) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
25' Nicolo Barella (Inter) picks up a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot goalwards that crashes against the bar. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
21' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
21' Denzel Dumfries (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Inter have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
20' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) latches on to a lofted pass and strikes a snap shot from outside the box. His effort curls way wide of the left post.
19' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle and it's Francesco Pio Esposito (Inter) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
17' The linesman raises his flag. Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is adjudged offside.
13' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) sends the corner into the box, but Yann Sommer intercepts it and averts the threat.

12' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Parma.
10' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Denzel Dumfries (Inter). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
9' The resulting corner from Federico Dimarco (Inter) is cleared.
8' What a chance that is! Enrico Delprato (Parma) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross, but he sends his header just over the crossbar.
7' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
4' Kevin Bonacina blows his whistle. Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) commits a foul after dangerous play.
2' Federico Dimarco (Inter) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
1' Marcus Thuram (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee blows his whistle, Inter are awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Parma will have the kick-off.
Kevin Bonacina will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
